title.en: An unofficial connector for Better Agent Terminal sessions
title.zh: Better Agent Terminal session 的非官方連接器

description.en: An unofficial MCP server and CLI that let AI agents and scripts read and wait on Better Agent Terminal sessions over BAT's remote protocol, and nudge or orchestrate them only on hosts where you enable it. Not affiliated with BAT's authors.
description.zh: 非官方的 MCP 伺服器與 CLI，讓 AI agent 和腳本透過 BAT 的遠端協定讀取、等待 Better Agent Terminal 的 session；只有在你開啟的主機上，才能推動或調度它們。與 BAT 作者沒有關係。

eyebrow.en: Unofficial · MCP server + CLI for BAT
eyebrow.zh: 非官方 · BAT 的 MCP 伺服器與 CLI

lede.en: It speaks BAT's own remote protocol, so Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Hermes, or a shell script can see which sessions are done, blocked on a question, or out of quota. Nothing writes until you enable it per host.
lede.zh: 它直接走 BAT 自己的遠端協定，讓 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Hermes 或一支 shell 腳本，都看得出哪些 session 做完了、卡在問題上，或是額度用完了。在你逐台主機開啟之前，它不會寫入任何東西。

meta.en: Rules over recent output · Jev off
meta.zh: 依最近輸出套用規則 · 未啟用 Jev

left.en: 1 session can fail over to Codex
left.zh: 1 個 session 可轉給 Codex

label.en: Current version, alpha, not on PyPI
label.zh: 目前版本，alpha，尚未上架 PyPI
MCP 工具：唯讀 13、寫入 7、調度 12

title.en: Several agents, several tabs, nobody watching.
title.zh: 開了一堆 agent，卻沒人在看。

body.en: Long-running coding agents finish, stall on a question, hit a usage quota, or just need "continue", and finding out means clicking through tabs. Screen scraping and GUI automation are brittle. BAT already has a remote protocol for its own desktop and phone clients, so the connector reads that, and a supervising agent does the checking.
body.zh: 長時間執行的 coding agent 會做完、會卡在問題上、會撞到用量額度，有時只差一句「continue」，而你只能一個個分頁點進去看。抓畫面、模擬 GUI 操作都很脆弱。BAT 本來就有一套給自家桌面與手機客戶端用的遠端協定，連接器直接透過這套協定讀取，讓負責監督的 agent 替你去看。

quote.en: Reading is always on. Anything that writes is opt-in per host, confirmed per call, rate-limited, and written to an audit log.
quote.zh: 讀取預設開放；寫入要逐台授權、逐次確認，並有限速與稽核。

title.en: Read first. Opt in to act.

intro.en: Each host has its own switches in hosts.toml, and they stack: orchestrate needs writes, allow_all needs writes, and auto_cleanup needs orchestrate.
intro.zh: 每台主機在 hosts.toml 裡有各自的開關，而且是一層疊一層：orchestrate 要先開 writes，allow_all 也要先開 writes，auto_cleanup 則要先開 orchestrate。

body.en: batc import-bat reads the BAT desktop client's profiles and writes hosts.toml with writes off: the wss:// URL, the pinned certificate fingerprint, and a token reference, never the token itself.
body.zh: batc import-bat 讀取 BAT 桌面客戶端的 profile，寫出寫入功能關閉的 hosts.toml：wss:// 網址、固定的憑證指紋，以及 token 的參照，不會存 token 本身。

body.en: Register the MCP server as "bat" in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Hermes, or any MCP client. Started read-only, it has only the 13 read tools, whatever the config says.
body.zh: 在 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Hermes 或任何 MCP 客戶端裡，把 MCP 伺服器註冊成「bat」。以唯讀模式啟動時，不管設定檔怎麼寫，都只會有 13 個唯讀工具。

body.en: sessions_triage labels every session (quota exhausted, waiting on a permission or a question, working, done) with an evidence line. session_wait blocks until a turn ends or a question appears.
body.zh: sessions_triage 替每個 session 標上狀態（額度用完、等權限或等回答、工作中、已完成），並附上判斷依據。session_wait 會一直等到回合結束或出現提問。

body.en: writes = true adds nudging, answering, and relaying. orchestrate = true adds worktree sessions, Codex failover, merges, and gated cleanup.
body.zh: writes = true 會加上推動、回答與轉達；orchestrate = true 再加上 worktree session、轉給 Codex 接手、merge，以及有關卡把關的清理。

title.en: Three tiers, and gates on anything that writes.

intro.en: 32 MCP tools and 32 batc subcommands. Only the read tier is on by default, and the tools of a disabled tier are never registered.
intro.zh: 共 32 個 MCP 工具、32 個 batc 子指令。預設只開唯讀層；沒開啟的權限層，工具根本不會註冊。

body.en: 13 tools list hosts, workspaces, and sessions, read transcripts in pages, wait for a turn to end, and show worktree diffs. The turn marker returned by a send keeps an older reply from being reported as the new result.
body.zh: 13 個工具可以列出主機、工作區與 session，分頁讀取對話，等待回合結束，並顯示 worktree 的 diff。送出訊息時拿到的 turn marker，可以避免把上一輪的回覆誤當成新結果。

body.en: With writes = true, 7 tools send a message, say continue, interrupt, answer a question or permission prompt, switch permission mode, or relay a person's words verbatim. Every call needs confirm=true.
body.zh: 開啟 writes = true 後多 7 個工具：送訊息、說 continue、中斷、回答提問或權限請求、切換權限模式，或逐字轉達某個人的原話。每次呼叫都要帶 confirm=true。

body.en: orchestrate = true, which needs writes, adds 12 tools: start sessions in fresh git worktrees, fan a bat-fanout plan out to parallel sessions, merge only clean, conflict-free branches, and remove worktrees. The default cap is 4 orchestrated sessions per host.
body.zh: orchestrate = true（必須先開 writes）再加 12 個工具：在新的 git worktree 開 session、把 bat-fanout 計畫分派給平行的 session、只 merge 乾淨且沒有衝突的分支，以及移除 worktree。預設每台主機最多同時調度 4 個 session。

body.en: Triage spots Claude sessions stopped by a usage quota from the limit text in the transcript. session_failover starts Codex in the same worktree and branch, with a handoff prompt that carries the original task, the latest instruction, recent output, and git state.
body.zh: Triage 從對話裡的額度提示文字，找出因為用量額度停下來的 Claude session。session_failover 會在同一個 worktree、同一個分支開 Codex 接手，交接 prompt 帶著原始任務、最新指示、最近的輸出與 git 狀態。

body.en: approve_pending answers permission prompts, never questions, with "don't ask again", then raises the session to allow-all. It only runs on hosts whose default_permission_mode is allow_all, and it never switches a Claude session mid-turn.
body.zh: approve_pending 只核准權限請求、不回答提問，核准時勾選「不再詢問」，再把 session 提升為 allow-all。它只在 default_permission_mode 設為 allow_all 的主機上執行，也絕不在 Claude 回合進行中切換權限。

body.en: session_cleanup is a dry run by default, and acting needs auto_cleanup = true on the host. It merges only when the worktree is clean, the branch is ahead, a passing verification record matches the commit, risk checks pass, and Jev agrees at 0.8 or higher. Branches are always kept.
body.zh: session_cleanup 預設只做 dry run，要真的動手，主機必須開啟 auto_cleanup = true。只有在 worktree 乾淨、分支領先、有對應同一個 commit 的通過驗證紀錄、風險檢查沒問題，而且 Jev 信心達 0.8 以上時，才會 merge。分支一律保留。

title.en: A client of BAT, not a part of it.
title.zh: 是 BAT 的客戶端，不是 BAT 的一部分。

intro.en: The connector is one more remote client of a BAT host, next to BAT's own apps. Its checks live in the client core, below the MCP layer, so the CLI and every MCP client get the same rules.
intro.zh: 連接器只是 BAT 主機的另一個遠端客戶端，和 BAT 自己的 app 並列。檢查都放在客戶端核心，位於 MCP 層之下，所以 CLI 與每個 MCP 客戶端套用的是同一套規則。

label.zh: Agent → 連接器 → BAT 主機

lines.zh: MCP 伺服器「bat」與 batc CLI

items.en: Unofficial: not affiliated with or endorsed by BAT's authors
items.zh: 非官方：與 BAT 作者沒有關係，也未經其背書

items.en: A TLS pin mismatch aborts before the token is sent
items.zh: 憑證指紋不符，就在送出 token 之前中止

items.en: Tokens come from env:, file:, or bat-profile: references and are redacted from errors
items.zh: Token 只從 env:、file:、bat-profile: 參照讀取，錯誤訊息一律遮蔽

items.en: Never sends reset, kill, PTY writes, file operations, settings, or installs
items.zh: 絕不送出 reset、kill、PTY 寫入、檔案操作、設定與安裝

items.en: No push, tag, or PR channel: merges stay in the host's main checkout
items.zh: 沒有 push、tag 或 PR 通道：merge 只留在主機的主要 checkout

title.en: Why it is shaped this way.

body.en: BAT's own clients already use bat-remote/v2, so the connector does too: no screen scraping, no GUI automation. The cost is coupling to a protocol read from BAT's source (v3.2.12) that can change between releases.
body.zh: BAT 自己的客戶端本來就用 bat-remote/v2，連接器也走同一套：不抓畫面、不模擬 GUI 操作。代價是綁在一套從 BAT 原始碼（v3.2.12）讀出來的協定上，而它可能隨版本改變。

body.en: A tool that does not exist cannot be talked into running. Write and orchestrate tools are registered only when some host enables them, and even then each call needs confirm=true.
body.zh: 不存在的工具，就不可能被說服去執行。寫入與調度工具只有在某台主機開啟時才會註冊，就算註冊了，每次呼叫也都要帶 confirm=true。

title.en: Code decides first, a model last
title.zh: 先由程式判斷，模型最後才上場

body.en: Cleanup checks git state, a verification record for the exact commit, and risk rules in code before it asks Jev anything. If Jev is unavailable, a merge escalates instead of going through.
body.zh: 清理流程先用程式檢查 git 狀態、對應同一個 commit 的驗證紀錄與風險規則，最後才問 Jev。Jev 不在時，merge 一律升級給人處理，不會直接放行。

body.en: Cleanup removes worktree folders but keeps every branch, so a merge or removal can be undone from the branch. Failover reuses the same worktree instead of copying work around.
body.zh: 清理會移除 worktree 資料夾，但每個分支都保留，merge 或移除之後都還能從分支救回來。Failover 直接沿用同一個 worktree，不把工作搬來搬去。

intro.en: You need Python 3.10 or newer on Linux or macOS, and a reachable BAT host with its remote server on. The package is not on PyPI yet, so install it from GitHub.
intro.zh: 需要 Linux 或 macOS 上的 Python 3.10 以上版本，以及一台連得到、已開啟遠端伺服器的 BAT 主機。套件還沒上架 PyPI，請直接從 GitHub 安裝。

body.en: Either command puts batc and bat-agent-connector-mcp on your PATH.
body.zh: 兩個指令擇一，都會把 batc 與 bat-agent-connector-mcp 放進 PATH。

steps.code:
uv tool install git+https://github.com/teddashh/bat-agent-connector
# or
pipx install git+https://github.com/teddashh/bat-agent-connector

body.en: Writes ~/.config/bat-agent-connector/hosts.toml with writes off, then reports version and ping per host. No BAT client on this machine? Start from examples/hosts.example.toml.
body.zh: 寫出寫入功能關閉的 ~/.config/bat-agent-connector/hosts.toml，再回報每台主機的版本與 ping。這台機器沒有 BAT 客戶端的話，就從 examples/hosts.example.toml 開始改。

title.zh: 以唯讀模式加入 MCP 伺服器

body.en: Claude Code is shown; the README has Codex, Cursor, Hermes, and HTTP setups. Then ask your agent which sessions are waiting for you.
body.zh: 這裡以 Claude Code 為例，Codex、Cursor、Hermes 與 HTTP 的設定寫在 README。接著就可以問你的 agent：哪些 session 在等我？

intro.en: Alpha, started in late September 2026 and changing daily. Every changelog entry is marked unreleased: no version tags, no GitHub releases, no PyPI package. BAT is by TonyQ; this project is not affiliated with or endorsed by BAT's authors, and a BAT update can break it.
intro.zh: Alpha 階段，2026 年 9 月下旬才開始寫，目前幾乎每天都在改。CHANGELOG 每一版都標著 unreleased：沒有版本 tag、沒有 GitHub release，也沒有 PyPI 套件。BAT 的作者是 TonyQ；本專案與 BAT 作者沒有關係、未經其背書，BAT 一更新就可能讓它失效。

works.en: Read tier: 13 MCP tools, plus the batc CLI with batc --json for scripts
works.zh: 唯讀層：13 個 MCP 工具，加上 batc CLI，腳本可用 batc --json

works.en: Per-host write and orchestrate tiers with confirm=true, rate limits (by default one write per session per minute, 30 per hour), and an append-only audit log
works.zh: 逐台主機開啟的寫入層與調度層：每次呼叫要 confirm=true，有速率限制（預設同一 session 每分鐘一次、每小時總共 30 次），並寫入只能附加的稽核紀錄

works.en: Triage from transcript patterns and BAT-STATUS markers, and quota failover to Codex in the same worktree
works.zh: 依對話內容規則與 BAT-STATUS 標記分類 session，額度用完時在同一個 worktree 轉給 Codex 接手

works.en: approve_pending and gated session_cleanup; cleanup never deletes a branch
works.zh: approve_pending 與有關卡把關的 session_cleanup；清理絕不刪除分支

works.en: A pytest suite against a mock TLS BAT server: 278 passed, 33 skipped in a local run on 2026-09-30
works.zh: 以模擬的 TLS BAT 伺服器測試的 pytest 套件：2026-09-30 本機執行，278 個通過、33 個略過

limits.en: The protocol was read from BAT's source (v3.2.12) and can change between BAT releases
limits.zh: 協定是從 BAT 原始碼（v3.2.12）讀出來的，BAT 改版時可能跟著變

limits.en: Linux and macOS only (it uses fcntl file locks)
limits.zh: 只支援 Linux 與 macOS（用到 fcntl 檔案鎖）

limits.en: Automatic merges need the optional Jev layer (a TypeSafe or OpenRouter key). Without it, cleanup keeps, cleans, or escalates, but never merges
limits.zh: 自動 merge 需要選用的 Jev 判斷層（TypeSafe 或 OpenRouter 的 key）。沒有它，清理只會保留、清掉或升級給人處理，不會 merge

limits.en: BAT's Codex sessions do not echo message IDs, so Codex turn tracking falls back to timestamps and Codex sends are not retried after a disconnect
limits.zh: BAT 的 Codex session 不會回傳訊息 ID，所以 Codex 的回合追蹤只能改用時間戳，斷線後也不會自動重送

limits.en: The task service (batc serve and the work_* tools) is experimental: its Goose planner is off by default, so submitted tasks stay queued
limits.zh: 任務服務（batc serve 與 work_* 工具）還在實驗階段：Goose 規劃器預設關閉，送出的任務會一直排隊

heading.en: The pin is checked before auth

intro.en: The connector is another remote client of a BAT host. A certificate mismatch stops the handshake.
intro.zh: 連接器是 BAT 主機的另一個遠端客戶端。憑證不符就停止交握。

note.en: An agent or batc asks the connector, which loads the token and does not send it yet.
note.zh: agent 或 batc 呼叫連接器時會讀入 token，但這時候還不送出。

note.en: The connector hashes the server certificate and closes the socket when it differs from hosts.toml.
note.zh: 連接器計算伺服器憑證的雜湊，和 hosts.toml 不同就關閉連線。

note.en: Only a matching pin is followed by the auth frame on bat-remote/v2.
note.zh: 只有指紋相符，才會接著送出 bat-remote/v2 的驗證訊框。

caption.en: On connect, the connector loads the host token from an env, file, or bat-profile reference. It then opens the WebSocket, hashes the server certificate, and closes the socket if that SHA-256 differs from the fingerprint in hosts.toml. The auth frame, which carries the token, is sent only after the pin matches. The protocol is bat-remote/v2.
caption.zh: 連線時，連接器先從 env、file 或 bat-profile 參照讀入主機 token，再開 WebSocket，計算伺服器憑證的 SHA-256。和 hosts.toml 裡的指紋不同，就關閉連線。帶著 token 的驗證訊框，只有在指紋相符之後才送出。協定是 bat-remote/v2。

intro.en: A tool that is not registered cannot be called. The tiers stack, and read-only mode strips the rest.
intro.zh: 沒註冊的工具就不能呼叫。權限一層疊一層，唯讀模式會拿掉其餘的工具。

note.en: Each host in hosts.toml has its own writes and orchestrate switches, and both start off.
note.zh: hosts.toml 裡每台主機有自己的 writes 與 orchestrate 開關，兩個預設都關。

note.en: Read tools always register, write tools need writes, and orchestrate tools need both, unless --read-only is set.
note.zh: 唯讀工具一定註冊，寫入要開 writes，調度要兩個都開，除非加上 --read-only。

note.en: 13 tools list hosts and sessions, read transcripts, wait, triage, and show worktree status.
note.zh: 13 個工具列出主機與 session、讀對話、等待、分類，並顯示 worktree 狀態。

note.en: 7 tools send, continue, interrupt, answer, set permissions, approve, or relay, and each call needs confirm=true.
note.zh: 7 個工具負責送出、繼續、中斷、回答、改權限、核准或轉達，每次都要 confirm=true。

note.en: 12 tools start worktree sessions, fail over, merge, and clean up, with a default cap of 4 sessions on a host.
note.zh: 12 個工具開 worktree session、接手、merge 與清理，每台主機預設最多 4 個。

caption.en: The MCP server named bat registers 13 read tools on every start. The 7 write tools register only when some host has writes, and the 12 orchestrate tools register only when some host has both writes and orchestrate. Starting with --read-only registers none of those write tools, whatever hosts.toml says. Orchestrate sessions on one host default to a cap of 4.
caption.zh: 名為 bat 的 MCP 伺服器每次啟動都註冊 13 個唯讀工具。7 個寫入工具只有某台主機開了 writes 才註冊。12 個調度工具要某台主機同時開 writes 和 orchestrate 才註冊。以 --read-only 啟動時，不管 hosts.toml 怎麼寫，那些寫入工具都不會註冊。一台主機的調度 session 預設最多 4 個。

heading.en: How a session gets its label

intro.en: Triage reads recent transcript text. Known patterns decide before the optional Jev layer.
intro.zh: 分類看的是最近的對話文字。已知的文字樣式先決定，選用的 Jev 排在後面。

note.en: The connector reads recent session output and any BAT-STATUS marker in it.
note.zh: 連接器讀取 session 最近的輸出，以及其中的 BAT-STATUS 標記。

note.en: Known quota, permission, question, and status strings decide before Jev is asked.
note.zh: 已知的額度、權限、提問與狀態文字先決定，之後才可能問 Jev。

note.en: Account-limit text is labeled quota_exhausted, which is the signal for Codex failover.
note.zh: 帳號額度文字會標成 quota_exhausted，這就是轉給 Codex 的訊號。

note.en: A permission prompt or a question is waiting, and cleanup keeps that session.
note.zh: 權限提示或提問會標成等待，清理流程會把這個 session 留著。

note.en: A streaming session stays working, and a finished idle one can carry a milestone marker.
note.zh: 還在串流的 session 算工作中，閒置且做完的可以帶里程碑標記。

caption.en: sessions_triage labels a session quota_exhausted, rate_limited_transient, waiting_permission, waiting_question, working, done_idle, error_other, or unknown. Deterministic transcript patterns and BAT-STATUS markers decide first, and each label keeps an evidence line. Jev is asked only for an ambiguous short error. If Jev is off or fails, the pattern result stands.
caption.zh: sessions_triage 會把 session 標成 quota_exhausted、rate_limited_transient、waiting_permission、waiting_question、working、done_idle、error_other 或 unknown。對話裡的固定樣式和 BAT-STATUS 標記先決定，每個標籤都留一行判斷依據。只有模糊的短錯誤才會問 Jev。Jev 沒開或失敗時，就維持樣式判斷的結果。

intro.en: A write needs confirm=true, then the audit log enforces the default rate limits.
intro.zh: 寫入要帶 confirm=true，接著由稽核紀錄執行預設的速率限制。

note.en: Every write tool call needs confirm=true, or the connector refuses it.
note.zh: 每個寫入工具都要帶 confirm=true，否則連接器會拒絕。

note.en: The default gap is 60 seconds for one session, and 30 writes an hour across hosts.
note.zh: 預設同一 session 要間隔 60 秒，所有主機一小時最多 30 次寫入。

note.en: Each attempt is appended to audit.jsonl, and with preview at 0 the line stores a hash and a length.
note.zh: 每次嘗試都附加到 audit.jsonl，預覽長度是 0 時只存雜湊與長度。

ticks.zh: 同一 session 隔 60 秒

caption.en: Write calls record an attempt in the append-only audit.jsonl and refuse when that log already shows 30 attempts in the last hour, or a newer attempt to the same session inside 60 seconds. A task's first prompt after its start channels can skip the 60 second gap, and it still counts toward the hourly cap. With the default preview length of 0, the line stores a short hash and the text length, not the prompt.
caption.zh: 寫入會在只能附加的 audit.jsonl 記一筆嘗試。過去一小時已經有 30 筆，或同一個 session 在 60 秒內有更新的嘗試，就會拒絕。任務在啟動通道之後的第一則 prompt 可以跳過 60 秒間隔，但仍計入每小時上限。預覽長度預設是 0，所以那一行存的是短雜湊和文字長度，不是 prompt 本身。

intro.en: A Claude session stopped by its account quota can be continued by Codex in the same folder.
intro.zh: Claude session 因為帳號額度停住時，可以由 Codex 在同一個資料夾接著做。

note.en: Triage marks the Claude session quota_exhausted from limit text in the transcript.
note.zh: 分類從對話裡的額度文字，把 Claude session 標成 quota_exhausted。

note.en: session_failover starts Codex in the same worktree and branch and leaves the Claude session in place.
note.zh: session_failover 在同一個 worktree 與分支啟動 Codex，原來的 Claude session 留在原地。

ticks.en: Claude quota text is the signal

caption.en: session_failover is an orchestrate tool. It refuses a session that does not look quota-exhausted unless force is set. The new Codex session uses the same worktree and branch when the Claude session had one, and the handoff prompt carries the original task, the latest instruction, recent output, and git state. The Claude session is not touched. This needs confirm=true.
caption.zh: session_failover 是調度工具。session 看起來不像額度用完時會拒絕，除非另外指定 force。Claude session 如果本來就有 worktree，新的 Codex session 會用同一個 worktree 與分支。交接 prompt 帶著原始任務、最新指示、最近輸出與 git 狀態。原來的 Claude session 不會被動到。這需要 confirm=true。

heading.en: What has to pass before a merge

intro.en: session_cleanup decides in code first. Jev is last, and a missing Jev escalates instead of merging.
intro.zh: session_cleanup 先由程式決定。Jev 排在最後，Jev 不在就升級給人，不會 merge。

note.en: The worktree must be clean, the branch strictly ahead, and the main checkout clean on the base branch.
note.zh: worktree 必須乾淨、分支必須嚴格領先，主要 checkout 也要在基底分支上且乾淨。

note.en: A passing verification record must match the current commit, and the last recorded test must not have failed.
note.zh: 通過的驗證紀錄必須對上目前的 commit，最後一筆測試紀錄也不能是失敗。

note.en: A merge needs a completion claim and a safe diff, both at confidence 0.8 or higher.
note.zh: 要 merge，完成宣告和 diff 判定都得是安全的，信心還要達到 0.8。

note.en: The default run only reports, a real merge needs auto_cleanup on the host, and the branch is kept.
note.zh: 預設只回報結果，真的 merge 要主機開 auto_cleanup，而且分支會留下。

ticks.en: git and tests are checked first

caption.en: session_cleanup returns MERGE_AND_CLEAN, CLEAN_ONLY, KEEP, or ESCALATE. A merge needs a clean worktree, a branch that is strictly ahead, a clean main checkout on the base branch, a passing verification record for that commit, no failed last test, and no risk hit in the diff. Jev must then report a completion claim and a safe_complete diff at confidence 0.8 or higher. If Jev is unavailable, the decision is escalate. dry_run is the default, acting needs auto_cleanup and confirm=true, and the branch is never deleted.
caption.zh: session_cleanup 會回傳 MERGE_AND_CLEAN、CLEAN_ONLY、KEEP 或 ESCALATE。要 merge，worktree 必須乾淨、分支嚴格領先、主要 checkout 在基底分支上且乾淨、有對上該 commit 的通過驗證紀錄、最後一筆測試沒有失敗，diff 也沒有風險命中。接著 Jev 必須給出完成宣告，以及信心達到 0.8 的 safe_complete diff。Jev 不在時，決定是升級給人。預設是 dry_run，真的執行動作要開 auto_cleanup 並帶 confirm=true，分支永遠不刪。
